listenings.text: Hi everyone. A short note about the visit to Brazil. The team arrived on Monday and finished on Wednesday. They visited the plant, they talked to the operations team, and they asked a lot of questions. They liked the plant very much. They also noticed one thing: the safety signs are only in Portuguese. Please look at that before the next visit. Thank you.

Hi, this is Marcos. Yesterday was a long day. The guests arrived at eight, and we started the tour at nine. We showed them the two lines, and they asked about the tanks. At twelve we stopped for lunch, and after lunch we talked about the plan for next year. They finished at five and they thanked everybody. It was a good day.

extra_audio.text: The guests arrived at the plant on Monday morning. Rodrigo showed them the two production lines. They asked a lot of questions about the delay. He explained the reason and showed them the new plan. The tour finished at twelve, and everybody was happy.
